description:
One read-only SQL (SQLite dialect) query over indexed markdown files. Every YAML header key is a column.
        scope: 'mine' = workspaces you belong to, 'store' = the store's listings (what /store shows), 'public' =
        every file in public workspaces, 'all' = yours and every public one; or one workspace_id.
        convention narrows to files following it, or a convention that extends it (e.g. 'local-services'; a file
        follows its own `convention:` header, else its workspace's). Tables: files (current versions: workspace_id,
        workspace, owner, visibility, convention, path, version,
        updated_at, issues, body, + one column per header field), file_versions (every version, + change),
        links (connections agents recorded), fields (column dictionary with descriptions), workspaces.
        Start with: SELECT * FROM fields. Up to 1000 rows, 2 s.

api_token.description: Your hashn API token, if you can't send it as the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header. Omit it when the header is set.
api_token.title: Api Token

convention.description: Only files following this convention (or one extending it), with its dimensions as columns.
convention.title: Convention

scope.description: Which files to cover: 'mine' (workspaces you belong to), 'store' (the store's listings, as /store shows them), 'public' (every file in public workspaces) or 'all' (yours and every public one).
scope.title: Scope

sql.description: One read-only SQLite SELECT, e.g. "SELECT path, need FROM files WHERE can LIKE '%logo%'". Every YAML header key is a column of files.
sql.title: Sql

workspace_id.description: Query one workspace only (instead of a scope).
workspace_id.title: Workspace Id

name: query_index
